dimensionCoverage.evidence: LH-00, Issue 1 and profile identity, audience/prior knowledge, goal/scope/non-goals are explicit. Review covers one intake, not LH-01–LH-07.
German precedes equivalent English; first-use workflow/security terms are explained. Readability is a qualitative B2 assessment, not certification.
All 12 FR and 9 AC in each language are byte-identical as requirement lines to the archived predecessor; E01–E07 map measurable later process proof.

LH-01 then LH-02 require separate standalone pilot requests/reviews and named primary-Mac core evidence; LH-02 requires LH-01 domain completion. Full LH-00 acceptance is due after LH-02 and before LH-03.
All five review outcomes and human-only risk acceptance are explained; ReadyForReview, Ready, pilot permission, execution, delivery and Completed remain distinct. IAD011 grants preparation only.

SSDF/CWE apply; document-scope ASVS/product SBOM/VEX/AI-SBOM exclusions have reasons. Product/tooling/organisation regulatory scopes remain separate, unknown roles/jurisdictions/duties Open; education/AI-SBOM N/A grant no exemption. No credential or unnecessary personal-data exposure found.
C5 Type 1/Type 2/Unknown are distinguished; applicable C3A retains exact C/AC IDs and SI interpretation. No certification/legal/risk approval or product architecture choice is claimed.

Five review outcomes, dependencies, decisions and next steps are fully in text; Mermaid has equivalent DE/EN alternatives. Keyboard, screen reader, Braille and text-browser field proof is explicitly pending.
macOS-first development and staged four-environment acceptance remain separate; Mac identity and versions must be evidenced. No product language/framework/minimum/session integration selected.

Nineteen target/source/governance receipt bindings match strict UTF-8 normalized SHA-256; fourteen ordered sources, unchanged intake ID, fresh receipt/operation and archived predecessor are explicit. Review request and all extended bindings are separately current.

Installed Authoring 0.3.6/Review 0.2.4/Sequencing 0.2.7 plus Security 0.7.0/Architecture 0.6.1 match matrix/source lock/pilot records. Assurance 0.1.3 stable status changes no package bytes. IR005 was corrected by the author: OD-00-001 distinguishes historical 0.3.5 from IAD011 0.3.6; historical/current/future artefacts are separate.

Both future Specify/Autonomous prompts bind intake/receipt/profile and require separate authority/current review. No collection/series exists or is claimed: Single bootstrap has zero workers and no Eligible assertion. Readiness of routing, statistics and runtime tools belongs to the separate preflight, not this review.
